why_ai: Licensed clinicians examine, test and treat walk-in patients in person.
why_clarity: Common presentations follow protocols across high volumes of short visits.
why_digital: Patients walk in, are examined by hand and treated on site locally.

why_ai: Moonlighting licensed clinicians treat patients in person when primary care is closed.
why_clarity: Walk-in visits follow protocols, with PCP handoffs adding coordination steps.
why_digital: In-person clinical care for nearby patients after hours.

why_ai: Trusted physician-authored graded recommendations, though AI clinical search competes directly.
why_clarity: Evidence grading is methodical, but each topic synthesis is distinct and slow to validate.
why_digital: Literature in, point-of-care reference content out online.

why_ai: Licensed clinicians treat injuries and perform DOT physicals and drug tests on site.
why_clarity: OSHA, DOT and drug testing workflows are codified and repeat often.
why_digital: Employees are seen in person at a clinic on the employer's site.

why_ai: Certified entities issue binding determinations, but choosing between offers on statutory factors is structured.
why_clarity: Each case picks one of two offers against fixed statutory factors at high volume.
why_digital: Offers and evidence submitted online, decisions issued electronically.

why_ai: The owner-physician treats patients in person under a medical licence.
why_clarity: Walk-in care follows protocols, while business management is ad hoc.
why_digital: Hands-on clinical care for a local walk-in population.

why_ai: Eligibility checks and E&M coding are rule-based revenue cycle tasks AI automates.
why_clarity: Coverage and code levels are verifiable against payer rules each visit.
why_digital: Insurance data and charts processed on screen, starting at the front desk.

why_ai: Curated coding interpretation history is an asset, though content drafting automates.
why_clarity: Code sets and edits are exact and updated on fixed schedules.
why_digital: Policy and code content published digitally.

why_ai: Licensed clinicians still examine and treat patients in person across many sites.
why_clarity: Standardised protocols repeat across dozens of locations.
why_digital: In-person clinical care in local clinics, with central analytics.

why_ai: Occupational physicians make return-to-work determinations, while routing and reporting automate.
why_clarity: Routing and reporting are routine; return-to-work outcomes show within weeks.
why_digital: Case data and authorisations managed on screen, routing workers to physical clinics.

why_ai: Timestamp-based bottleneck detection and wait prediction are well-defined optimization software.
why_clarity: Door-to-door time is measured instantly at every visit.
why_digital: EHR timestamps in, flow insights out, improving physical clinic waits.

why_ai: Negotiators trade on payer relationships and cross-client rate knowledge in adversarial talks.
why_clarity: Rate models are numeric, but each negotiation differs by payer and market.
why_digital: Rate data and contracts handled remotely.

why_ai: Pediatric clinicians examine children in person with weight-based dosing and age-specific risks.
why_clarity: Age-normed vitals and dosing are codified and repeat across visits.
why_digital: Children are examined and treated in person at local clinics.

why_ai: Assays are developed at the bench and FDA clearance requires accountable clinical evidence.
why_clarity: Assay sensitivity and specificity are measured against defined reference methods.
why_digital: Physical test kits developed in labs and shipped to clinics nationally.

why_ai: Normalising machine-readable price files is data engineering AI handles well.
why_clarity: Monthly files are normalised the same way, though source errors complicate checks.
why_digital: Published price files in, rate benchmarks out.

why_ai: Often the only facility for 30 miles, treating higher-acuity patients and deciding transfers.
why_clarity: Higher-acuity, varied presentations make stabilise-or-transfer decisions less routine.
why_digital: Hands-on care where connectivity is unreliable and no alternative exists.

why_ai: Public health agencies hold authority to trigger outbreak responses, a government function.
why_clarity: Daily monitoring is routine, but outbreak signals are confirmed only later.
why_digital: Encounter feeds in, alerts out, run only by jurisdictional agencies.

why_ai: Surveyors visit centres in person, but accreditation is voluntary and few payers require it.
why_clarity: Published standards are applied to each site survey.
why_digital: On-site surveys produce written findings and certification decisions.

why_ai: Benchmark surveys on member submissions are routine work AI tools reproduce.
why_clarity: The same operating metrics are surveyed each year.
why_digital: Member submissions in, benchmark reports out.

why_ai: Defending missed-diagnosis claims is adversarial and actuarial pricing is accountable.
why_clarity: Pricing methods exist, but claim outcomes surface years after the policy year.
why_digital: Claims and exposure data analysed on screen; defence runs through courts.

why_ai: Claims submission, denials and coding audits are rule-based billing work.
why_clarity: Claims are paid or denied against payer rules thousands of times.
why_digital: Claims data processed and submitted electronically.

why_ai: Demand forecasting and staffing models automate, though acquisition and site calls are strategic.
why_clarity: Visit forecasts are checked against actual volumes each season.
why_digital: Encounter and financial data modelled on screen for internal leadership.
